notes: «- المعنى -» and «- قال مسدد - خطب يوم الفتح - ثم اتفقا -» are Abu Dawud's own wording glosses on the two transmitters; the second names no new route, so they are left out
The two sayings of the Prophet (the blood-money clause and the pre-Islamic glory clause) share one chain: one group, no saying labels
Abdullah b. Amr is the Companion whose report the saying is
